data.body: **P2 — Avoid consuming a sampler decision for the remote-parent probe.** With an undecided complete remote parent, a stateful plain sampler is queried for `Workflow` before any span exists; the real `Invocation` and `Workflow` spans then receive later decisions. A one-shot or rate-limited sampler can consequently export no SDK span despite initially returning `RECORD_AND_SAMPLE`. Remove this preflight for plain samplers or make its result authoritative for the real SDK spans, and assert that remote-parent tests observe only real-span evaluations.
